cases.dictionary_meaning: the underlying course, principle, or path by which things operate or are followed
cases.nuance: In this text it refers to the fundamental Way, not an ordinary road.
cases.retained_context: 道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；
cases.retained_context_translation: The way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.

example_pairs.aligned_translation: People do not speak of right and wrong.
I spoke of it to the others.
The sage does not speak his name.
